thread:
maria: Quick async check-in for docs/devex stuff — what I did: pushed Netlify fixes for the quickstart site, updated python SDK README examples, and added a CI smoke test for the sampleapp. Blockers: mac-arm wheel build failing on CI, and sampleapp Docker image is huge (~1.2GB). Today: trim Docker layers, get wheels green, and try to merge PR #402. ping @jo for review :pray:

jo: On it — I'll do a review after lunch. For the mac-arm wheel, logs showed clang failure and a missing build flag. Can you paste the wheel log? Might be fixed by switching to cibuildwheel or adding the proper mac flags.

sachin: I can take the Docker image slimming. I noticed we're apt-installing a bunch of packages we don't need and copying full model weights into the final image. I'll try multi-stage + download-at-runtime with cache.

maria: Good call — I'll add a Dockerfile flag SKIP_WEIGHTS_COPY so CI can skip copying weights during tests. That should cut size.

devex-bot: CI update: build/quickstarts-py failed on mac-arm (wheel). Logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/1760012345/log — snippet: "error: invalid value '-mno-asm' for '-m'"

tim: Quick doc note for PR #402: example config still uses `model_name` key; new SDK expects `model`. Small nit that causes a deprecation warning and confuses docs generation.

lina: If folks are touching the python SDK, please also bump the docs metadata (sphinx conf) — I hit broken crossrefs when generating nightly docs yesterday.

jo: Reviewed the diff so far, left 2 tiny comments on README formatting and a missing type hint. Will re-review after patches.

sachin: Pushed docker slimming patch: removed locales, cleaned apt caches, moved pip deps to build stage, and switched to multi-stage. Local image down to ~640MB. Diff refs: ```git show --name-only 9f2b6c2```

maria: Awesome — that should help. Plan: hold merge until wheels are green and jo approves. ETA: aim to merge by EOD, then trigger a docs smoke deploy. If mac-arm still fails, fallback plan is to build wheels on a hosted runner with cibuildwheel and upload to test index. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jo: Sounds good. Ping me once CI is green and you've addressed my comments.

maria: Will do. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
